title: Snowbound: The $89 Shovel
author: Claude
blurb: Dowden Additions, December 1992: shovel Gale Street, Dunn Drive, Leota Street and Leon Drive at $1 a scoop, sled down Jamie Street, work Bowden Drive, and get $89 to LaVale Mall before the price of Game-Maker goes up.

box.tagline: Every driveway is a dollar. Every dollar is a pixel.
box.back:
December 1992. Eighteen inches of snow, school is closed, and the pink box at Bits & Bytes Software in LaVale Mall costs $89 - until January, when it goes up to $129.

Grab your shovel and open for business at home, on the corner of Gale Street and Dunn Drive. Dig out the neighbors on Gale and Leota (no mailboxes in Dowden Additions - the mail carrier walks to every door, so the front walks pay too), take Leon Drive to the top of Jamie Street and sled it to the bottom grabbing the dollars that blow loose, work Bowden Drive while the plows roar by, and dig out the LaVale Mall parking lot as the squall keeps burying it again. Bonk snow forts flat, outrun Biscuit the dog, make Big Pete cry with a well-aimed snowball, try not to spend it all at Timeout - and get that coffee can to the register before closing.
features: Six real neighborhood streets and LaVale Mall, from a pink winter sunrise to a snowy night, with day turning to dusk
Deep snow you shovel by walking into it - every scoop pays $1
A sled run down Jamie Street with real momentum: steer, brake and push off
Snowball fights with forts, a bully and a very friendly dog
A parking lot that snows back over while you work - and the Timeout arcade, a quarter at a time
An animated FLI intro, nine original Sound Blaster FM songs and digitized sound effects
